(c) If you’re visiting a major European city, set aside time to explore its vibrant street food markets, where you can experience authentic flavors and local culture in a lively setting. You might also enjoy strolling through architectural landmarks and sampling local cafés for a touch of the city’s daily life.
(d) If you’re visiting a major European city, set aside time to see its most famous attractions, such as iconic landmarks, historic neighborhoods, or key cultural sites. You might also enjoy strolling through architectural landmarks and sampling local cafés for a touch of the city’s daily life.
